title: Linh's Coral Reef Challenge in Phu Quoc
keywords: Phụ nữ trong các ngành STEM
segments: Linh arrived in Phu Quoc for her summer science program. Mr. An, a kind local leader, greeted her warmly. He explained the beautiful coral reef nearby needed urgent help. Because of this, Linh decided to investigate the problem. She spent days researching the coral reef and the special equipment needed to save it from pollution. She quickly realized that collecting and managing cash donations would be very difficult. Then, an idea sparked: a modern banking app could help gather funds easily and transparently for the project.

After that, Linh shared her banking app idea with Mr. An. He was excited but unsure about using new technology. Linh patiently showed him and some villagers how to set up accounts and receive small donations. They practiced sending and receiving money. Linh then used her STEM skills, setting up the camera to monitor the coral reef. She felt proud, seeing technology help protect nature. The reef was now safer.

After that, the reef slowly began to recover, thanks to Linh's monitoring and the community's care. Mr. An thanked Linh for her amazing help. Her STEM skills and the banking app truly made a difference. Linh felt happy, knowing her project helped protect Phu Quoc’s beautiful nature for everyone. It was a big success.
endWrap: What a journey! Linh showed how technology and teamwork can save nature. Her story inspires us to use our skills for good. The coral reef is safe!
